text: dsh-ASD-100 是面向 DSH 的提示与命令插件：开启后，它把 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语规则加入每次请求的 system prompt，帮助回复和文档采用清楚直接的表达。输入 /asd100 on 开启、/asd100 off 关闭、/asd100 查询状态。插件从用户技能目录或随包文件读取规则，缺失时使用内置规则。模式由共享状态文件控制，适合希望统一 DSH 英文写作风格的用户。代码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ASD-100 adds ASD-STE100 simplified English rules to DSH prompts when enabled. Use /asd100 on or /asd100 off to change the mode, and /asd100 to check it. Rules load from a skill file or built-in fallback. A shared state file controls the mode. No API key or external service appears in code.
想让 DSH 的回复和文档都遵循简化技术英语规则。
我需要一个命令来切换 DSH 的英文写作模式。
How can I make DSH use simpler technical English in every response?
dsh-ASD-100 的功能「注入简化英语规则」：开启模式后，插件将技能正文或内置规则加入 DSH 的 system prompt；关闭时不注入。用户用 /asd100 on 或 /asd100 off 控制。
dsh-ASD-100 的功能「切换和查询模式」：输入 /asd100 on 开启、/asd100 off 关闭，或输入 /asd100 查看状态。插件把模式保存在共享标记文件中。
dsh-asd-100 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 34 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。
dsh-asd-100 README · dsh-ASD-100：Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document.

dsh-asd-100 README · What it does：When the mode is on, the plugin adds an always-on section to the system prompt of
every request. The section holds the writing rules of simplified technical English:
20 words in a procedure sentence, 25 in a descriptive sentence, one instruction per
sentence, active voice, simple tenses, the condition before the command, one word
with one meaning, no semicolons, no em dashes, no contractions. A reply answers
first and uses prose only.

dsh-asd-100 README · Commands：- `/asd100 on` turns the mode on.
- `/asd100 off` turns the mode off.
- `/asd100` reports the current state.

`/asd-100` is accepted as an alias.

dsh-asd-100 README · State：The mode is one flag file: `~/.dsh/dsh-asd-100/.active`. The plugin reads it on every
request, so all sessions share the state and a change takes effect at once. To turn
the mode off from outside the chat, delete the file.

dsh-asd-100 README · Where the rules come from：The rules ship with the plugin in `skills/simple-english/`, so a fresh install follows
the full rule set and the four reference files it points to. When
`~/.agents/skills/simple-english/SKILL.md` exists, that copy wins, and you can edit
your own rules there. When neither copy exists, the plugin uses a built-in rule set
of nine lines. All three paths are in `lib/index.js`.

dsh-asd-100 README · Config：Two optional fields, set in the bundle patch that loads the plugin:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-asd-100
      name: dsh-asd-100
      config:

dsh-asd-100 README · Development：```sh
node --test test/ste.test.mjs
```

The plugin imports node builtins only. It has no dependencies.

dsh-asd-100 README · Files：- `lib/index.js` — the plugin: the prompt section, the command handler, the flag file.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that loads it.
- `skills/simple-english/` — the rule text and its references, spliced from the
  `simple-english` agent skill (MIT), version 2.1.1, standard ASD-STE100 Issue 9.
- `test/ste.test.mjs` — seven tests.
- `awesome-dsh-plugin-entry.yml` — the list entry for the awesome-dsh-plugin PR.
